title: Equipment maintenance decision
goal: Show safety-first maintenance routing for a monitored production asset.

rubric.must: The root visibly asks whether the equipment is safe to operate.
The safe path visibly checks condition-monitoring alarm limits and preventive-maintenance due date.
The unsafe path visibly asks whether the hazard can be isolated and leads to lockout or emergency shutdown.
An out-of-limit condition visibly branches to planned corrective work or reduced-load urgent repair.
All visible leaves state an operational maintenance action.

ideal.notes: Redrawn from the source with the independent taxonomy exemplar drawing script; no engine geometry or screenshot used to build the target.

review.evidence: Visually reviewed against the taxonomy exemplar and source: complete questions and outcomes, numbered hexagons, unambiguous Yes/No drops, and a shared outcome row. No clipped labels or material collisions. Unclassified outcomes remain neutral.
